prediction.what_the_falsifier_said_it_would_mean: 'proximity to the data is what matters and the recipe must ride along with the record.' THAT READING DOES NOT HOLD. On sonnet, which made the call, the guidance channel scored 10/10 route-correct — the same as the response arm and the description arm. The recipe did not need to travel with the record. It needed to be FETCHED, and haiku never fetched it.

the_real_finding.discovery_is_model_dependent: sonnet read the one-sentence pointer and made the no-argument call first in 10/10 runs (then the lookup). haiku went straight to the lookup in 10/10 runs. The pointer is in the delivered description in both cases (it is 150 chars long).
the_real_finding.without_the_recipe_haiku_improvises: All 10 haiku guidance-recipe runs derived from the payload with no conversion constants: invented 85–90% or 90% boiler efficiency (3 runs, fabricated), used the 41 m² BAG area instead of the 40.02 m² thermal zone (most), one took the ep2_fossiel road, one applied a hybrid/renewable discount (80–150 m³). 5 of 10 landed in band by luck. 0 of 10 were route-correct.
the_real_finding.given_the_recipe_the_channel_does_not_ma: sonnet: 10/10 route-correct in all three arms. haiku: words-recipe 7/10, inline-recipe 6/10 route-correct (value 7 vs 7) — a tie between description and response once both deliver, the third time after Q15 and Q15b. Q1b's 4/30 vs 29/30 is fully accounted for by delivery.
the_real_finding.cost: sonnet median subagent_tokens: guidance-recipe 51,962 (two calls), inline-recipe 53,646, words-recipe 66,133 (uncut descriptions of every tool: +23% over inline-recipe, as in Q15b). The guidance call is not dearer than the response channel even with its extra round trip.

what_this_changes: A guidance call (bootstrap tool) is a working channel ONLY for models that make it. On haiku, with a one-sentence pointer in the description, it was never made. It is not safe as the SOLE carrier of anything a weak model needs.

The production `start_duurzaam` pattern is exposed to exactly this: its description says 'Call WITHOUT parameters first', and whether a given model does is now a measurable, model-dependent question, not an assumption.

Design guidance: put what every model needs where every model receives it — the response of the call it will make anyway, or the first 2,048 chars of that tool's description. A guidance call is an addition, not a substitute.

Q9's distance half builds on this arm with an enforced call order; the natural-discovery result here means distance must be tested with the guidance call forced (e.g. by protocol), or it will measure discovery again.
